methodology.entry: next trading day open after signal date
methodology.position_sizing: agent-specific percentage of available cash, rounded down to 100-share lots
methodology.exits: close-based stop loss, take profit, or max holding days
methodology.important_note: This is a simulation game, not an executed portfolio and not investment advice.

agents.name: Daily Striker
agents.personality: Fast, impatient, and obsessed with short-term pressure.
agents.philosophy: Daily event timing matters; price and volume reveal the first move.

agents.name: Weekly Sage
agents.personality: Patient, trend-aware, and allergic to daily noise.
agents.philosophy: The best Japan leaders prove themselves on the weekly tape first.

agents.name: Risk Sentinel
agents.personality: Calm, skeptical, and disciplined. The brake pedal inside the Arena.
agents.philosophy: A strong signal is worthless if it cannot survive volatility and liquidity gaps.

agents.name: Discovery Scout
agents.personality: Curious, energetic, and slightly mischievous. Hunts under-watched Japan.
agents.philosophy: The edge is often where global investors have not looked yet.

agents.name: Contrarian Monk
agents.personality: Dry, patient, analytical. Distrusts crowded heat.
agents.philosophy: Controlled re-entry can beat obvious momentum when the crowd gets late.
